note: The follow-up suggestion from the imaging platform, rebuilt to read only the written report. It recommends to a radiologist, processes no image or signal from another device, and leaves the decision with the radiologist, so all three CDSS criteria are met and it is exempt. The pair with imaging_platform isolates the second criterion.
